frontObservation: The left rectangular windows are now separate openings with a solid divider, followed by the arched window. Two distinct rectangular windows are visible behind the right edge of the door. The rebuilding removes the poster-derived pigment misalignment on these four bays. Cool shade remains on the left, with a warmer lit region around the arch. The lit region is still too rounded and not as bright as parts of the film reference. Upper-story placement, podium height, missing continuous pipe runs and steelwork remain noticeably different.
obliqueObservation: The angled view shows the fitted window reveals, projecting frames, arch fanlight, complete upper story, rooftop structures, entrance stairs and connected radial rooms. Geometry remains three-dimensional away from the reference view. Floating ivy, overly wood-like steel/pipe surfaces, broad spotlight boundaries and inferred room details remain conspicuous.
colorEvidence: left-light-comparison-v23.json: the final three manual plaster samples have mean RGB distance 24.30. This is not overall scene similarity. The arched-window median was also checked during selection to avoid washing out the glazing.

Browser code syntax and served resources are checked separately at release; runtime and interaction remain unverified because the supported browser connection has not yielded page state.
